theme_and_archetype.description: A clean, modern research-tool aesthetic combining the structure of a data science notebook with the clarity of a SaaS dashboard. Calm neutral background, one confident accent color, generous white space, and clear structural lines.

rules: Use Chivo for all Headings (High-contrast, authority, clean).
Use Work Sans for Body text (Readable, functional).
Use JetBrains Mono for code blocks and data metrics (Technical precision).

hierarchy.h1: font-sans font-bold tracking-tight text-4xl sm:text-5xl text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: font-sans font-semibold tracking-tight text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900
hierarchy.small_label: font-body text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

rules: Use Slate-900 as the primary Call-To-Action color (e.g., 'Next Step', 'Run Experiment').
Use the Fairness (Teal) and Effectiveness (Blue) colors ONLY for semantic color-coding of metrics, badges, and chart elements. Do NOT use them for primary navigation or generic CTAs.
Disabled options must look explicitly disabled (reduced opacity, greyed out) but still readable.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboard areas (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Use generous single-column or 2-column layouts for the Wizard steps.

surface_styles.notebook_cell: bg-white border-l-4 border border-slate-200 rounded-r-lg p-6 shadow-sm

components.wizard_header: Horizontal progress bar at the top of the container. Show 'Step X of 7' explicitly with a Shadcn Progress bar.
components.disabled_options_with_tooltip: Wrap disabled standard elements in a Shadcn Tooltip. The tooltip MUST explain the constraint reason (e.g., 'Not compatible with categorical data').
components.multi_select_chips: Use small rounded badges (bg-slate-100 text-slate-700) with an 'x' to remove, for sensitive attribute selection.
components.script_preview_modal: Shadcn Dialog containing a pre formatted code block with `font-mono`, `bg-slate-900`, `text-slate-50` and basic syntax highlighting colors.
components.simulated_progress: A Shadcn Progress bar that auto-increments via state, showing text phases: 'Queued' -> 'Running' -> 'Computing metrics' -> 'Done'.
components.results_dashboard: Use Recharts. Bar chart or Pareto scatter plot utilizing the two-tone color coding (Teal for fairness metrics, Blue for effectiveness). Highlight the 'Best Trade-off' in a prominent Card.
components.tables: Shadcn Table with sortable headers. Use monospace fonts for numerical data.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Default to variant='outline' for secondary actions, variant='default' (Slate-900) for primary.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react icons. Keep stroke width to 1.5 for a clean, technical look.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) instead of heavy drop shadows to create structure.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Subtle background color shifts on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50) rather than scale transforms.

empty_state_image.description: Abstract geometric data visualization for the Dashboard empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
2. Implement a robust 7-step wizard state machine. Steps: 1:Dataset, 2:Data Scaler, 3:ML Model & Task Type, 4:Fairness Methods, 5:Fairness Metrics, 6:Tradeoff Strategy, 7:Validation/Review.
3. Enforce constraint logic: E.g., if a certain Data Scaler is selected, specific ML Models might be disabled. Show the disabled model with a Tooltip explaining why.
4. Step 5 must use plain-language guided questions that progressively reveal metric checkboxes with associated weight input fields.
5. Use the specific two-tone color palette (Teal-700 for Fairness, Blue-700 for Effectiveness) to distinguish metrics in the Results page charts and tables.
6. Build a simulated run process using a timeout-based state progression for the Progress bar.
7. Include mock export buttons ('Export .csv', 'Export .dill') on the results page that trigger a toast notification instead of actual download.
8. Load required Google Fonts (Chivo, Work Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts import in the main CSS file.
